# SQLite source distribution

The build compiles SQLite 3.54.1 from the unmodified public-domain amalgamation. CMake verifies the archive with the upstream SHA3-256 digest `92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`. Thread safety is enabled and external extension loading is omitted. [Source archive](https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip) · [Release](https://www.sqlite.org/releaselog/3_54_1.html) · [License](https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html)
